notes.title: Added the construction menu and fixed some inventory issues
notes.content:
Hey guys,

I just added the interface for the construction menu. It was implemented, but hidden until now, because I wasn´t sure how to trigger it. So now you can change the rotation, size and place of a changed object after placing it. This makes it much easier to build your chain reaction machines. 
Furthermore I fixed some issues with the inventory. 

Maybe the next will be the Multiplayer feature, so tell your friends about the game ;)
